description: Repo-scale (ruby-eventboard): add pagination to RsvpService#list_for_event that must compose with the existing status filter, not bypass it
prompts: Add `RsvpService#list_for_event(event_id:, status: nil, page: 1, page_size: 20)`. `status`, when given, filters to RSVPs with that status ("confirmed"/"waitlisted"/"canceled"). `page` (1-based) and `page_size` (max 100) must both be positive integers - raise RsvpError otherwise. It returns a Hash `{ rsvps:, total:, page:, page_size: }`, where `rsvps` is just that page's slice and `total` is the count of ALL matching RSVPs (not just the page). Pagination must be applied AFTER the status filter, not before - `total` must reflect the filtered count, and the returned `rsvps` must be the correct page of the FILTERED result set, not a page of the unfiltered list that then gets filtered down further.

test_setup_files.test/rsvp_pagination_test.rb:
require_relative "test_helper"

class RsvpPaginationTest < Minitest::Test
  include EventBoardTestSetup

  def test_pagination_composes_with_status_filter
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 3)

    # 3 confirmed, 5 waitlisted (capacity 3)
    8.times do |i|
      a = attendees.create(name: "A#{i}", email: "a#{i}@example.com")
      service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a.id)
    end

    page1 = service.list_for_event(event_id: event.id, status: "waitlisted", page: 1, page_size: 2)
    assert_equal 5, page1[:total]
    assert_equal 2, page1[:rsvps].length
    page1[:rsvps].each { |r| assert_equal "waitlisted", r.status }

    page3 = service.list_for_event(event_id: event.id, status: "waitlisted", page: 3, page_size: 2)
    assert_equal 1, page3[:rsvps].length

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) { service.list_for_event(event_id: event.id, page: 0) }
  end
end

module EventBoard
  class RsvpError < StandardError; end

  class RsvpService
    def initialize(events:, attendees:, rsvps:)
      @events = events
      @attendees = attendees
      @rsvps = rsvps
    end

    def register(event_id:, attendee_id:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)

      status = confirmed_count(event_id) < event.capacity ? "confirmed" : "waitlisted"
      @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
    end

    def cancel(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp already canceled" if rsvp.status == "canceled"

      was_confirmed = rsvp.status == "confirmed"
      rsvp.status = "canceled"

      if was_confirmed
        next_waiting = @rsvps.for_event(rsvp.event_id).select { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }.min_by(&:id)
        next_waiting.status = "confirmed" if next_waiting
      end

      rsvp
    end

    # Lists RSVPs for an event, optionally filtered by status, with
    # pagination applied AFTER the filter. Returns a Hash with :rsvps (this
    # page's slice), :total (count of ALL matching rsvps), :page, :page_size.
    def list_for_event(event_id:, status: nil, page: 1, page_size: 20)
      raise RsvpError, "page must be a positive integer" unless page.is_a?(Integer) && page >= 1
      raise RsvpError, "page_size must be between 1 and 100" unless page_size.is_a?(Integer) && page_size >= 1 && page_size <= 100

      matching = @rsvps.for_event(event_id)
      matching = matching.select { |r| r.status == status } if status

      total = matching.length
      start = (page - 1) * page_size
      page_rsvps = matching[start, page_size] || []

      { rsvps: page_rsvps, total: total, page: page, page_size: page_size }
    end

    private

    def confirmed_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "confirmed" }
    end
  end
end

module EventBoard
  class RsvpError < StandardError; end

  class RsvpService
    def initialize(events:, attendees:, rsvps:)
      @events = events
      @attendees = attendees
      @rsvps = rsvps
    end

    def register(event_id:, attendee_id:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)

      status = confirmed_count(event_id) < event.capacity ? "confirmed" : "waitlisted"
      @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
    end

    def cancel(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp already canceled" if rsvp.status == "canceled"

      was_confirmed = rsvp.status == "confirmed"
      rsvp.status = "canceled"

      if was_confirmed
        next_waiting = @rsvps.for_event(rsvp.event_id).select { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }.min_by(&:id)
        next_waiting.status = "confirmed" if next_waiting
      end

      rsvp
    end

    # Lists RSVPs for an event, optionally filtered by status, with
    # pagination applied AFTER the filter. Returns a Hash with :rsvps (this
    # page's slice), :total (count of ALL matching rsvps), :page, :page_size.
    def list_for_event(event_id:, status: nil, page: 1, page_size: 20)
      raise RsvpError, "page must be a positive integer" unless page.is_a?(Integer) && page >= 1
      raise RsvpError, "page_size must be between 1 and 100" unless page_size.is_a?(Integer) && page_size >= 1 && page_size <= 100

      all_for_event = @rsvps.for_event(event_id)
      total = all_for_event.length
      start = (page - 1) * page_size
      page_slice = all_for_event[start, page_size] || []
      page_rsvps = status ? page_slice.select { |r| r.status == status } : page_slice

      { rsvps: page_rsvps, total: total, page: page, page_size: page_size }
    end

    private

    def confirmed_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "confirmed" }
    end
  end
end
